notes: List-typed fields (string_list, object_list) are exchanged as JSON-encoded strings. Fields with group=company are assembled into profile.company[0].

fields.label: Industry Unique Identifier
fields.description: Unique identifier of the professional in the industry / source system (for example an industry reference number).

fields.label: Source URL
fields.description: URL of the profile page this record was extracted from.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Full name of the professional.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Job title or role label of the professional (for example Partner Agent or Broker Associate).

fields.label: Display Picture
fields.description: URL of the professional's profile photo, headshot or avatar.

fields.label: Cover Image
fields.description: URL of the cover, banner or hero image of the profile.

fields.label: About
fields.description: Biography or self-description of the professional.

fields.label: Address Line 1
fields.description: Street address of the professional's office: street and number only, without city, state or zip.

fields.label: City
fields.description: City of the professional's office address.

fields.label: State
fields.description: State or region of the professional's office address (2-letter code when available).

fields.label: Zipcode
fields.description: Postal / ZIP code of the professional's office address, as text (keep leading zeros).

fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the professional's office location, as a decimal number.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the professional's office location, as a decimal number.

fields.label: Office Phone
fields.description: Office or main business phone number of the professional.

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Direct, mobile or cell phone number of the professional.

fields.label: Fax
fields.description: Fax number of the professional.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Primary email address of the professional.

fields.label: Website
fields.description: Personal or business website URL of the professional. Not a social network page and not the crawled profile page itself.

fields.label: Facebook Link
fields.description: URL of the professional's Facebook page.

fields.label: LinkedIn Link
fields.description: URL of the professional's LinkedIn profile.

fields.label: Instagram Link
fields.description: URL of the professional's Instagram profile.

fields.label: Specialities
fields.description: Areas of expertise, focus areas or services the professional specializes in, as a list of short phrases.

fields.label: Licenses
fields.description: Professional license numbers held by the professional, as a list of license number strings.

fields.label: Positions
fields.description: Work experience history: one entry per company the professional has worked for, each with company_name, title and year (for example a year or 'Present').

fields.label: Operating Hours
fields.description: Weekly operating hours as a list with one entry per day: day, open (opening time) and close (closing time).

fields.label: Years of Experience
fields.description: Number of years of professional experience, as a whole number.

fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: Name of the company, brokerage or firm the professional works for.

fields.label: Company Address Line 1
fields.description: Street address of the company's office: street and number only.

fields.label: Company City
fields.description: City of the company's office.

fields.label: Company State
fields.description: State or region of the company's office.

fields.label: Company Zipcode
fields.description: Postal / ZIP code of the company's office, as text.

fields.label: Company Email
fields.description: Primary email address of the company.

fields.label: Company Phone
fields.description: Main phone number of the company.

fields.label: Company Latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the company's office, as a decimal number.

fields.label: Company Longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the company's office, as a decimal number.

fields.label: Company Source URL
fields.description: URL of the page the company details were taken from.

fields.label: Company Facebook
fields.description: URL of the company's Facebook page.

fields.label: Company Instagram
fields.description: URL of the company's Instagram page.

fields.label: Company LinkedIn
fields.description: URL of the company's LinkedIn page.

fields.label: Company Twitter
fields.description: URL of the company's Twitter page.

fields.label: Company YouTube
fields.description: URL of the company's YouTube channel.

fields.label: Company Yelp
fields.description: URL of the company's Yelp page.

fields.label: Company Google My Business
fields.description: URL of the company's Google My Business page.

fields.label: Company Other Social Links
fields.description: Company profiles on any other social network (for example Twitter or Google My Business), as a list of entries with network and url.

fields.label: Company Website
fields.description: URL of the company's website.
